scientific.integrity: The infinite-family proof is symbolic. Exhaustive enumeration through order twelve checks the local threshold criterion, every enumerator coefficient, and the minimum-set formula on 269 ordered blade-size tuples.
scientific.limitations: The theorem covers global offensive alliances with margin one on heterogeneous windmills with at least two blades. It does not assert strong or general \(k\)-offensive analogues. Search-based originality remains subject to poorly indexed or inaccessible older literature.

title: All global offensive alliances of heterogeneous windmill graphs
